pieces.title: Four poles
pieces.caption: Stoicism, Confucianism, Spinoza Conatus and The Drift at four corners, wearing their own avatars, with a red line wherever the map says one contradicts another. Only the Drift contradicts the striving. *What is real and what is a choice:* The four red lines are real 'contradicts' links. 'The striving' and 'no architecture' paraphrase the page. Palace Philosophies calls this site a quadruple; this page names the fourth pole and says it is not yet on its map. *Leaking in:* Stoicism, Confucianism, Spinoza Conatus, The Drift.

verdicts.file: The Fortress and the Threshold — rich — four poles.png
verdicts.why: The links are right but one is drawn wrong: the Drift–Confucianism line runs straight through the centre icon, so it reads as this page joined to those two rather than one contradiction between them. The caption's "this page sits in the middle holding all four" is Palace Philosophies' claim, not this page's: the body says the Drift "does not currently sit on the entry's map" and the forward vector says absorbing it is the next development.
